children: European equity markets were poised for a subdued opening on Monday as caution prevailed amid expectations that major central banks could raise interest rates in the near term.
Markets increased bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike this month after stronger-than-expected US jobs data.
The European Central Bank is likewise expected to raise rates this week to 2.75%, with investors also pricing in another hike in December.
Rate expectations were reinforced by rising inflationary risks as oil prices climbed further after the US and Iran exchanged strikes on ships over the weekend.
Meanwhile, investors will assess another reading of Eurozone Q2 GDP along with final data on employment changes during the quarter.
In premarket trading, Euro Stoxx 50 and Stoxx 600 futures were little changed to slightly lower.

title: European Stocks Set for Cautious Open
